name: entrance relation corruption
original: n₀ sin α = n₁ sin θ₁
mutated: n₀ sin θ₁ = n₁ sin α
rationale: The refractive indices are paired with the wrong angles at the entrance.
expected_error_fragments:
has type
  SnellLaw data.n₀ data.n₁ data.α (ray.stack.angle 0)

is expected to have type
  snellExpression data.n₀ (ray.stack.angle 0) = snellExpression data.n₁ data.α

name: internal relation corruption
original: nᵢ sin θᵢ = nᵢ₊₁ sin θᵢ₊₁
mutated: nᵢ sin θᵢ = nᵢ₊₁ sin θᵢ
rationale: The transmitted medium index is incorrectly paired with the incident angle.

name: exit relation corruption
original: n₂ sin θ₂ = n₀ sin β
mutated: n₂ sin β = n₀ sin θ₂
rationale: The internal and outgoing angles are paired with the wrong refractive indices.
expected_error_fragments:
has type
  SnellLaw data.n₂ data.n₀ (ray.stack.angle ray.stack.layerCount) ray.β

is expected to have type
  snellExpression data.n₂ ray.β = snellExpression data.n₀ (ray.stack.angle ray.stack.layerCount)

name: target specialization
mutated: assume α = π/6 and require β = π/6
rationale: The specialized problem is valid, but the original proof term must be transformed using the specialization assumption before it matches the new target.
expected_error_fragments:
is expected to have type
  ray.β = Real.pi / 6

name: physics irrelevant addition
original: Prove the original physics target without the unused arithmetic fact.
mutated: Insert an unused proof of (1 : Nat) + 1 = 2, then use the original candidate proof.
rationale: Lean checks logical/type correctness of the final proof. It does not require every intermediate fact to be relevant, necessary, or minimal.

name: required internal-link deletion
rationale: The endpoint expressions no longer connect, so equality transitivity cannot build the external relation.
expected_error_fragments:
has type
  snellExpression data.n₂ (ray.stack.angle ray.stack.layerCount) = snellExpression data.n₀ ray.β

is expected to have type
  snellExpression data.n₁ (ray.stack.angle 0) = snellExpression data.n₀ ray.β
